versions.description: Scheduled server restarts that warn players and wait for a safe moment. Set restart times as cron expressions (default 04:00 UTC every day). Players get countdown warnings (default 30, 15, 5 and 1 minutes before). Before the shutdown the module can save the world and kick everyone, with a save and shutdown command per game (7 Days to Die saveworld, Rust server.save, Minecraft save-all); by default Takaro's own shutdown is used. Safe window: a restart waits while it would hurt players and tries again every few minutes, up to a max delay. Built-in checks: 7 Days to Die blood moon (game time and BloodMoonDay), at least N players online, a recent PvP kill, and your own console checks (run a command, wait while the output matches a pattern). Admins use restartnow <minutes> and restartcancel; everyone can type restartstatus. Optional Discord announcements.

commands.name: restartstatus
commands.description: Shows when the next server restart is, or why it is on hold.
commands.helpText: restartstatus = time until the next server restart.

commands.name: restartnow
commands.description: Admin: restart the server in N minutes with warnings (0 = right away).
commands.helpText: restartnow [minutes] = restart with a countdown (default 5). restartnow 0 restarts right away. Skips the safe-window checks.

commands.name: restartcancel
commands.description: Admin: cancel the restart that is counting down, or skip the next scheduled one.
commands.helpText: restartcancel = stop the current countdown or hold. With nothing counting down it skips the next scheduled restart.

hooks.name: on-player-death
hooks.description: Remembers the last PvP kill for the 'Wait after a PvP kill' check.

cronJobs.name: tick
cronJobs.description: Every minute: start the countdown for scheduled restarts, send warnings, check the safe window and restart.

functions.name: rm-helpers

permissions.description: Restart the server with restartnow and cancel or skip restarts with restartcancel.
